linkedin.text:
Every shortlist starts the same way: the same four European cities, the same hotel chains, the same itinerary your people already did with their last employer.

This is the alternative — a desert camp outside Marrakesh, built for a full corporate group, photographed on the trip we ran there.

The argument for it is not exotics. It is contrast. A team that spends the year in meeting rooms responds differently to a place that looks nothing like a meeting room. That is the entire mechanism behind incentive travel, and a familiar city dilutes it.

What makes it work operationally: short flight, no visa friction for most passports, and ground infrastructure that handles 200+ without improvising.

Want a shortlist that isn't the same four cities? Send us the brief.
